name: Posteryard
description: Clean, consistent posters for Plex, Jellyfin and Emby, picked, rendered and kept current automatically. Posteryard gives every movie, show, season and episode the same calm look: clean art without printed text, the title logo in one fixed spot, a soft fade, and small badges for 4K, Dolby Vision, Dolby Atmos and the streaming service. It finds the art on TMDB, checks it, renders it, uploads it and keeps it up to date. With Live TV on, it does the same for the shows and movies in the Plex or Jellyfin guide. It starts with Dry Run on: images go to the previews folder in Data and the server is not touched. Set Dry Run to false when you like them. For new titles right away, add the webhook http://Unraid-IP:8098/webhook/YOUR-WEBHOOK-SECRET in Plex under Settings, Webhooks. For Jellyfin and Emby, see the README. Without it, new titles get posters within 15 minutes.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Database, previews and custom art. Keep this, or every image is rendered and uploaded again.

ports.name: Webhook Port
ports.description: Port for the Plex, Jellyfin or Emby webhook and the /healthz check.

variables.name: TMDB API Key
variables.description: A free key from TMDB, under Settings, API. The API Read Access Token works too.

variables.name: Plex URL
variables.description: Your Plex server's address on the network, such as http://192.168.1.10:32400. Not localhost. Leave it empty for Jellyfin or Emby.

variables.name: Plex Token
variables.description: Your Plex token. Leave it empty for Jellyfin or Emby.

variables.name: Webhook Secret
variables.description: Any long random text, such as the output of openssl rand -hex 16. It is part of the webhook address.

variables.name: Dry Run
variables.description: true saves previews and changes nothing on your server. false uploads the images and locks them.

variables.name: Libraries
variables.description: Libraries to manage, separated by commas, named as your server shows them. Movie and TV libraries only. PLEX_LIBRARIES works too.

variables.name: Streaming Regions
variables.description: Countries to look up a show's streaming service in, in order. Outside the US, put yours first, such as GB,US.

variables.name: Notify URLs
variables.description: Where alerts go: Apprise addresses separated by spaces or commas, for Discord, Telegram, ntfy, email and about 100 more.

variables.name: Notify Events
variables.description: Which alerts are sent: problems, new and summary.

variables.name: Jellyfin URL
variables.description: Your Jellyfin server's address. Use it instead of PLEX_URL and PLEX_TOKEN.

variables.name: Jellyfin API Key
variables.description: A Jellyfin API key, from API Keys in the Jellyfin dashboard.

variables.name: Emby URL
variables.description: Your Emby server's address. Use it instead of PLEX_URL and PLEX_TOKEN.

variables.name: Emby API Key
variables.description: An Emby API key, from API Keys in the Emby dashboard.

variables.name: Maintainerr URL
variables.description: Your Maintainerr address, for the LEAVING IN 5 DAYS countdown.

variables.name: fanart.tv API Key
variables.description: Your fanart.tv API key. A second art source when TMDB has nothing clean.

variables.name: Apple TV Art
variables.description: Use Apple TV's key art when TMDB has no textless poster.

variables.name: Text Check
variables.description: Check art for printed titles and skip it. false saves about 350 MB of memory on small machines, but a few posters may show the title twice.

variables.name: Only Rating Keys
variables.description: Limit Posteryard to a few titles, for a first test. Rating keys separated by commas. A show includes its seasons and episodes.

variables.name: Minimum Video Badge
variables.description: Lowest resolution that gets a badge: off, 720, 1080 or 2160.

variables.name: Minimum HDR Badge
variables.description: Lowest HDR format that gets a badge: off, hdr10, hdr10plus or dolbyvision.

variables.name: Minimum Audio Badge
variables.description: Lowest audio that gets a badge: off, 5.1, 7.1 or atmos. DTS:X counts as atmos.

variables.name: Accessibility Badges
variables.description: Subtitle and audio description badges on movies: any of sdh, cc and ad, separated by commas. Read from the track flags, or from track names such as "English (SDH)".

variables.name: Status Labels
variables.description: JUST ADDED, NEW EPISODE and NEW SEASON labels. false turns them off.

variables.name: Episode Thumbnails
variables.description: plain adds a light shade, titled adds the episode number and title, off gives episodes back their server thumbnails.

variables.name: Logo Languages
variables.description: Title logo languages in order, such as fr,en.

variables.name: Prefer Wordmark
variables.description: Prefer a wide logo with the name written out. false allows tall or square logos.

variables.name: Collection Posters
variables.description: Give every collection a poster.

variables.name: Live TV
variables.description: Posters for the shows and movies in the Live TV guide, on Plex and Jellyfin.

variables.name: Service Collections
variables.description: Keep one collection per streaming service with at least 3 shows.

variables.name: Sweep Minutes
variables.description: Minutes between checks for new and changed titles.

variables.name: Daily Pass At
variables.description: Time of the daily full pass, as HH:MM in your TZ.

variables.name: Heartbeat URL
variables.description: An address Posteryard calls every minute while healthy, such as an Uptime Kuma push URL.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: debug, info, warning or error.
